inputs.original_text:
Folks, let’s talk about what really matters here: basic national sovereignty, secure borders, and the fundamental integrity of our electoral process. The radical left is trembling at the mere thought of accountability and the rule of law. We saw this clear as day on Tuesday when White House border czar Tom Homan appeared on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” where he rightly refused to rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places and demanded to know what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

While the mainstream narrative whines about inconsistent answers from the Trump administration, the reality is simple. If you have nothing to hide and you are here lawfully, why would you fear the presence of lawful authorities ensuring that our sacred civic duties are protected from subversion? This is about standing up for tradition, enforcing our laws, and preserving the nation for our citizens. The Democrats and their progressive allies only care about eroding our borders and our standards, but true leadership means putting the security and order of the American family first.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, let’s look at what’s really at stake here for our nation, our families, and our traditional way of life. The radical left is terrified of accountability and the rule of law, and we saw that clear as day on Tuesday when White House border czar Tom Homan appeared on “The Charlie Kirk Show.” 

True leadership is about standing up for tradition, enforcing our laws, and preserving the nation for our citizens, putting the security and order of the American family first. When asked about immigration enforcement at polling places, Homan rightly refused to rule it out and demanded to know what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

The mainstream narrative can whine all it wants about inconsistent answers from the Trump administration, but the reality is simple. If you have nothing to hide and you are here lawfully, why would you fear the presence of lawful authorities ensuring that our sacred civic duties are protected from subversion? This is about basic national sovereignty, secure borders, and the fundamental integrity of our electoral process. The Democrats and their progressive allies only care about eroding our borders and our standards, but we must demand order and stand firm for our citizens.
